---
description: Draft test cases for a story in the team table format
---
For the story I name, draft test cases as a table with the columns: id, type (nominal or edge), steps, expected result.
Use sample ids like TEST-0001 only. Do not invent numbers: take them from the story or list them as questions.
Add edge cases for: no previous result, a result outside the window, a unit mismatch, a change exactly at the limit.
End with a list of your assumptions, written as questions for a person to answer.
